''See also: [[Life aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Life [[aura]], also referred to as [[vital aura]], is a vibrant green energy that can be perceived through Spiritual sight{{!}}spiritual sight or specialized [[Copper sight]]. It manifests as a powerful, glowing presence that can appear like an emerald bonfire in dense vegetation or as a bright line of light running down a person's spine. This [[aura]] serves several critical functions: it acts as a protective mechanism that reacts automatically to defend a person against Death aura{{!}}death aura, and it serves as the fundamental power that anchors a soul to its physical body. Within an individual, this lifeline can be used to restore health or combat exhaustion, though damage to the lifeline is difficult to repair. The strength and thickness of an individual's [[vital aura]] can influence the speed and safety of their [[advancement]] through the unity of [[aura]]. Furthermore, certain environments or [[natural treasures]] can be used to bolster this energy, with some specialized sources even capable of restoring youth. While it is a source of nourishment and comfort, life [[aura]] can also be consumed by predatory forces or shadows.}}
